messages:
sam: Pager fired — sudden spike in 5xx/timeouts from inference gateway (us-west-2). Start ~11:32 UTC. Error pattern looks like encoder process crashing (segfault / OOM) and then gateway 502s. Noticed increase in model-runner restarts and pod evictions. Triage and mitigation please.

maria: seeing it on metrics: encoder memory grows before crash, but sometimes segfault without OOM in kernel logs. Customer-facing latency up ~3s and error rate to 8% for text-gen routes.

lee: copying logs, small snippet: ```
[11:32:18] model-runner-5ffb encoder.cpp:142 Allocation failure at size=268435456
[11:32:18] kernel: oom-kill: pid 4123 (model-runner) total-vm: ...
[11:32:19] model-runner[4123]: segfault at 0x7f... ip ...
```

dev-ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-217. Pager duty notified. Oncall: sam -> lee (11:40 handoff window).

sam: quick checklist — set fallback routing to non-quantized model variant, disable batching for encoder-heavy requests, and remove affected pods from LB pool while we debug. Who can run the reroute?

maria: I'll flip fallback now. Doing: `redwoodctl route update --from model/x-quant --to model/x-cpu-fallback --region us-west-2 --weight 100`

lee: disabling batching on the encoder service to avoid large allocations. Patch: `env BATCHING=false` applied to infer-encoder deployment; starting restart.

maria: fallback confirmed — traffic to cpu-fallback at ~11:36 UTC. Error rate dropped to ~1.5% but latency increased ~200ms. Noted some customers still hitting 502s due to cached LB entries.

sam: good. Can we isolate a small reproducer? Any recent model or runtime change deployed ~last 24h?

lee: deployment history: no model version rollouts in last 18h; we did a kernel patch on a subset of infra for node health yesterday but only in eu-west. The encoder binary was rebuilt 3 days ago with quantization fixes. Attaching gitrev: `rev: a1c2d3f`

maria: also seeing KV-cache growth on affected nodes — >3GB per connection before crash. Could be a leak in prefix caching with quantized path.

dev-ops-bot: Hotpatch suggestion: revert to older encoder binary build for a small canary group and observe. Use canary tag `encoder:stable-2026-03-10`

lee: initiating canary rollback on 10% of pods now. `kubectl set image deploy/infer-encoder infer-encoder=redwood/encoder:stable-2026-03-10 -n prod`

sam: customer impact note: CS notified — 14 customers reported intermittent 5xx in last 30m, highest impact for high-concurrency streaming routes. Logged in INC ticket.

maria: telemetry after rollback canary: canary pods stable for 6 minutes, no OOM or segfault observed. Rolling additional 30% with conservative rollout.

lee: diag command output from surviving pod: `pmap -x <pid>` shows heap growth correlated to KV cache entries. We should enable aggressive KV eviction on quantized path as short-term mitigation.

sam: agreed. Maria, can you push the KV eviction tuning? Lee, keep rolling the stable binary.

maria: pushed KV eviction config: `kv_cache.max_prefix_entries=16000 kv_cache.eviction_policy=LRU aggressive=true` applied via configmap and restarted pods.

dev-ops-bot: Alert: gateway 502s declining to baseline over last 6m. Continue monitoring for 30m.

lee: rollout complete to 100% stable binary now. No further segfaults in cluster for 12m.

sam: preparing incident summary for postmortem: root cause suspected memory leak in encoder quantized code path leading to OOM and segfault; fallback + rollback + KV eviction mitigations brought service back. Will capture timeline and customer impact (14 customers, ~33 minutes elevated error window). Assigning postmortem owner: maria.

maria: I'll start the postmortem draft and include metrics, logs, and the canary rollback timeline. Tagging @engineering and @eng-ml for deep-dive.

pagerbot: Reminder: handoff to night oncall at 19:00 UTC. Next steps documented in INC-2026-217.

sam: thanks team — closingpager once incident page updated and postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
